assets.name: campaign-art-v1
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original feature artwork for SendMailOS email marketing website, in exactly the same material family as its premium cobalt-metal email envelope hero.
Style: exceptional photorealistic 3D industrial product photography, tactile satin anodized cobalt-blue metal, slightly softened machined edges, translucent smoked-blue glass, thin icy-blue edge reflections, restrained blue light accents, real global illumination, soft grounded shadow, very subtle studio-floor reflection. Background is seamless uniform midnight navy #07101d. Colors cobalt #3978f6, navy #07101d and tiny ice-blue #a7c8ff highlights. Expensive, precise, calm editorial art direction. No purple, green or orange.
Composition: landscape 4:3, one central sculptural composition occupying around 70% of the image, all important objects fully inside the frame with 12% breathing room. Objects are large enough to read inside a website feature card at 350px width. Real three-quarter dimensional perspective, crisp and clean.
Constraints: ARTWORK ONLY. Absolutely no readable text, letters, numbers, logos, screenshot, UI, dashboard, buttons, labels, grid, circuit board, person, watermark, flat/vector/cartoon style, excessive neon bloom or confusing clutter. This is a symbolic still life, not a product interface.
Subject: email campaigns and announcements. A beautiful open cobalt-blue metal envelope sits at a slight angle. One elegant ivory-tinted frosted glass message sheet rises from it. Three smaller glossy cobalt-blue folded envelopes fan out along ONE graceful luminous blue arc behind the larger envelope, conveying one announcement reaching its audience. Beautifully composed physical objects with real depth, not a diagram or many scattered icons. Main envelope in the lower middle, glass sheet upper middle, small envelopes spaced sparingly. Refined balanced composition.
assets.optimization: WebP quality85 at1200px, quality82 at640px; proportional resizing only

assets.name: connection-bg-v1
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: full-width background image for the final call-to-action section of SendMailOS website. Must match its satin cobalt-blue metal email envelope and smoked-blue glass hero.
Primary request: a beautifully art-directed dark navy studio composition that visually frames an EMPTY center for large website text. In the lower LEFT corner, a large sculptural cobalt-metal folded email envelope is partly cropped by the left and bottom edges, with refined rounded folds and fine satin texture. In the upper RIGHT corner, a pair of translucent smoked-blue glass message sheets and a smaller folded blue metal envelope are partly cropped by the right edge. One very fine luminous blue light ribbon curves along the OUTER lower edge and then toward the far right, joining the two groups; tiny sparse icy-blue points are on the ribbon. No object or bright streak crosses the middle text area.
Composition: wide landscape 16:9. The central 60 percent of image WIDTH, between x=20% and x=80%, and central 75 percent of HEIGHT must remain almost completely empty uniform very dark navy #07101d. Objects occupy ONLY the far left and far right margins, intended as atmospheric decorative background framing. Low enough contrast near the center to preserve white and pale-blue headline readability. No central emblem.
Style: exceptional photorealistic 3D studio product photography, physical anodized cobalt metal #3978f6, smoked glass, soft white/ice-blue #a7c8ff rim lights, realistic refraction, subtle satin details, restrained luminous accents, very soft navy surface reflections. Calm, expensive, spacious and confident, same premium industrial material world as the hero. No excessive bloom.
Constraints: image artwork only. NO text, numbers, letters, logos, watermark, UI, webpage, screenshot, badges, labels, faces or people. No purple/green/orange. No diagrams, circuit board or noisy particle field. The empty center is crucial. Objects may bleed outside the frame at the corners but must remain recognizable as elegant email sculptures.
assets.optimization: WebP quality86 full-size, quality82 mobile1000px; proportional resizing only
